endpoint_note: bespoke multipart /api/v1/convert with asynchronous polling; NOT OpenAI-chat-compatible, so the harness run_openai.py cannot drive it
provenance_caveat: Hosted API row. RESULTS.md 'What counts as a score' requires self-run inference under a pinned image and model revision; a hosted endpoint cannot attest serving configuration or quantization. Any `served_versions` above is what the API volunteered, not a pin.
request_settings_note: disable_image_captions and additional_config.keep_page{header,footer}_in_output are undocumented form fields; captions are figure descriptions rather than transcription, and the furniture flags set this row's policy to match the verbatim rows (see DESIGN.md, 'The furniture trade-off')
wall_clock_note: cumulative across every pass of this run, not just the last invocation. Totals marked `migrated` were recovered on 2026-08-30 from the checkpoint's filesystem timestamps rather than timed live; see each pass's migration_note and evidence. null means the passes cannot be separated from the idle time between them, and only an upper bound is knowable.

evidence.method: macOS st_birthtime -> st_mtime on runs/<dir>/checkpoint.jsonl, which is append-only and fsynced after every page; the span therefore brackets every pass that wrote to it. Valid only because the file was never deleted and recreated between passes.

wall_clock_passes.migration_note: recovered 2026-08-30. The recorded 2233.5 s timed one invocation; the checkpoint's birthtime->mtime span is 2228.7 s, a 0.21% difference, so that invocation was the whole run — an earlier pass would have created the checkpoint sooner and widened the span beyond the recorded elapsed. Checkpoint holds 2165 lines over 2165 unique PageIDs (0 superseded), consistent with a single pass. The recorded elapsed is kept as the total because it timed the process; the span is slightly shorter only because the checkpoint is created after startup.
wall_clock_passes.started_at_note: checkpoint birthtime; the pass began moments earlier, before the first page was written
